blocks.text: What is Amazon Textract?
Extract text and structured data such as tables and forms from documents using artificial intelligence (Al)-no configuration or templates necessary.
Go beyond simple optical character recognition (OCR) by extracting relationships, structure, and text from documents.
Improve security and compliance through robust data privacy, encryption, security controls, and support compliance standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, and more.
Easily implement human reviews with Amazon Augmented Al (A2l) to manage nuanced or sensitive workflows and audit predictions.

blocks.text: What is Amazon Textract?
Extract text and structured data such as tables and forms from documents using artificial intelligence (Al)-no configuration or templates necessary.
Go beyond simple optical character recognition (OCR) by extracting relationships, structure, and text from documents.
Improve security and compliance through robust data privacy, encryption, security controls, and support compliance standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, and more.
Easily implement human reviews with Amazon Augmented Al (A2l) to manage nuanced or sensitive workflows and audit predictions.
